title: [social] LinkedIn comment: 3 people asked if the FORGE lifecycle (Obs
objective: Turn field capture CAP-20260703T214356Z-0122 into reusable substrate capability.

source_context.raw_text: LinkedIn comment: 3 people asked if the FORGE lifecycle (Observe->...->Improve) could be sold as a consulting diagnostic for solo founders drowning in scattered notes.

evidence.description: Original field capture (social): LinkedIn comment: 3 people asked if the FORGE lifecycle (Observe->...->Improve) could be sold as a consulting diagnostic for solo founders drowning in scattered notes.

constraints: Must not require the founder to install anything; markdown + a short questionnaire only
acceptance_criteria: A named lifecycle diagnostic exists that a solo founder can self-score in under 10 minutes

artifacts_created.description: Lifecycle Continuity Diagnostic: 12-question self-score template mapping a founder's current habits to the Observe->Improve loop, with a weak-link recommendation
Diagnostic delivery workflow: capture -> score -> weak-link report -> optional consulting upsell

decisions_made.intent: Package the Observe->Improve loop as a standalone scored diagnostic instead of a bespoke consulting engagement
decisions_made.evidence: 3 independent LinkedIn commenters asked for a self-check version of the loop, not a custom engagement
decisions_made.reasoning: A repeatable scored diagnostic is far cheaper to deliver than 1:1 consulting and doubles as a lead magnet into paid consulting
decisions_made.alternatives_considered: Considered a live workshop format; rejected due to scheduling overhead for a first test
decisions_made.outcome: Approved: build a 12-question lifecycle diagnostic template
decisions_made.lesson_learned: Signal from 3+ people asking the same question is strong enough to prototype before a fourth request arrives

validation_results.result: Scored the diagnostic against this repo itself: weakest link was 'Govern' (no reviewable decision log existed before this mission) - matches observed reality, template is discriminating correctly

commercial_opportunities.who_benefits: Solo founders and small teams with scattered notes/ideas across phone and laptop
commercial_opportunities.problem_solved: No structured way to turn a captured idea into reusable organizational capability; ideas get lost between phone and laptop
commercial_opportunities.notes: Free 12-question diagnostic as lead magnet; paid tier turns diagnostic output into a configured ForgeWorld mission package for their own stack

lessons_learned: A single strong repeated market signal (3 asks) is enough evidence to justify a first prototype, without waiting for more
Packaging our own internal lifecycle as an external diagnostic is a zero-marginal-cost way to validate the substrate's commercial value
next_recommended_action: Draft the actual 12 questions for lifecycle-diagnostic-template.md and pilot it on 2 real solo-founder contacts before publishing publicly
